text.description_html:
TC2203 Global Door Controls Door Surface Mount Door Closer

Global Series TC2203 Door Closer is an economically priced door closer for use on interior or exterior doors in commercial and storefront applications. They fit 8 3/16" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Global Series TC2203 Door Closers are non handed and, for standard non-hold open or hold open applications. They can be mounted on regular and top jamb installations. An optional mounting bracket is available for parallel installations.

The TC2203 offering spring power size 3 for use on doors up to 155 pounds.

Optional Back Check Speed Adjustment for out-swing doors that are subject to wind gust. Back Check slows the door in the opening swing to help keep it from hitting an adjacent wall or having wind throw it out of your control. Backcheck resistance is only felt near the fully open position.

Specifications and Features:

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Optional Adjustable Back Check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 8 7/8"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 8 3/16"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 155 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 36" interior / 30" exterior
  • Non Handed
  • Grade 3
  • UL 10C (Fire test) Approved
  • Spring Size: 3
  • 10 Year Manufacture Warranty

NOTE: the standard arm shown in the upper right product image is included.

If desired, you can add an optional Parallel Arm Bracket PAB-2200 and / or Optional Hold Open Arm HOA-1245 below.

The Back Check Speed Adjustment feature of this TC2003 door closer is also an option for even more versatility.
